verdict.rationale: Devin itself functions as the built-in AI assistant to which tasks are delegated across web app, terminal, Slack/Teams, and API, with rich first-party documentation of the delegation workflow (docs-1,3,4,5,8,19).  Community feedback raises reliability/skepticism concerns but does not concretely contradict that delegation itself works, so it's not disputed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of delegation reliability/success rate beyond old demo critiques.
